start: A gym invite link (https://<gym-link host>/j/CODE) opened on a phone in no gym

user_sees: Screen 'Join your gym'
'Finding your gym…' with a spinner, then the gym's name and look
must_not: Another gym's name or logo
A join made before any tap

steps.action: Read the lines and check the name box
user_sees: 'Join to see your membership and your gym's messages here. Your workouts stay on this phone.'
The leaderboard name note
'Your name' box filled from the profile name
must_not: The name box filled with someone else's name

steps.action: Tick 'I'm 18 or older, and I agree to MettleUp's terms and privacy notice' and tap 'Join this gym'
user_sees: The button shows it is busy
The app moves on to the gym (or back to the check-in when opened from the poster)
must_not: Two members made at the gym for one tap
The join sent before the box is ticked

start: Welcome screen, 'Join my gym', no invite link

steps.action: Tap 'Join my gym', then type the 6-letter gym code under 'or type the gym code' (or scan 'Scan the poster at your gym')
user_sees: The gym's name checked against the code
A button 'Join <gym name>'
must_not: A wrong code accepted without a word
The member's name sent to a gym the code does not name

user_sees: The same 'Join your gym' screen with the tick box and name box
must_not: A join without the 18+ tick

start: Invite screen open, the gym found

steps.action: Tap 'Join this gym' without ticking the box
user_sees: 'Please tick the box above. You need to be 18 or older and agree to the terms and privacy notice.'
must_not: Any call to the gym
A member made at the gym

steps.action: Tick the box, clear the name box and tap 'Join this gym'
user_sees: 'Type your name so the desk knows whose order it is.'
must_not: An empty-name member at the gym

steps.action: Open a link whose code no gym has
user_sees: The 'gym not found' card with a way back to the code box
must_not: A spinner that never ends
A join attempt

start: Joined a gym by link, then the same link opened again

steps.action: Open the same invite link again
user_sees: 'You're already in <gym>. Nothing to do.' and 'Open your gym'
must_not: A second member made at the gym
The tick box asked again

steps.action: A retry after a lost answer within 15 minutes (same join id)
user_sees: The same member is given back
must_not: A second row for the same person on the gym's list

steps.action: Read the lines above the button, then join
user_sees: The leaderboard note (other members see the name only if switched on)
When the gym's trainer view is live: 'Your gym and your trainer see your workouts, so they can help you progress.'
must_not: Workouts shared with the trainer without that line shown first
The name shown to other members on the leaderboard without the member switching it on

start: Phone already in gym A; an invite link for gym B opened

user_sees: 'You're in <gym A> now. Switching takes you out of <gym A> on this phone.'
A button 'Switch to this gym'
must_not: The switch done before any tap

steps.action: Tick the 18+ box and tap 'Switch to this gym'
user_sees: A question about open shop orders at gym A when there are some
Then gym B's screen
must_not: Gym A's open orders left waiting at gym A's desk
The phone left in no gym when the join to B fails

start: Phone in gym A; gym A's own invite link opened (for example from the check-in poster)

user_sees: 'You're already in <gym A>. Nothing to do.'
'Open your gym'
must_not: A second member made at gym A
A switch question

start: Phone in gym A; switching to gym B with no internet

steps.action: Tick the box and tap 'Switch to this gym' while offline
user_sees: 'No internet. Try again when you're online.'
must_not: The phone taken out of gym A
Gym A's messages and plans wiped from the phone

start: Switched from gym A to gym B

steps.action: Look at the Gym tab after the switch
user_sees: Gym B's name, look and messages only
must_not: Gym A's messages, plans or diets still shown
Gym A still listing this phone as a member after it confirms the leave

start: Phone in gym A, switching to gym B

user_sees: Gym B gets the name typed in the box only
must_not: Gym A's records (plan, check-ins) sent to gym B
Workouts shared with gym B's trainers without the line shown first
